user.title: Connect to the controller
user.description: Enter the controller address and the account you use in its web interface.

data_description.host: Address of the controller, for example http://192.0.2.10.
data_description.email: E-mail address of the controller account.
data_description.password: Password of the controller account. Only a derived login token is stored.

site.title: Choose a site
site.description: Each configuration entry covers one site. Add the integration again for other sites.

reauth_confirm.title: Authentication expired for {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The controller rejected the stored login for {email}. Enter the password again.

abort.no_sites: The account has no sites on this controller.
abort.wrong_account: The password belongs to a different account than the one configured.

access.title: Configure an access device
access.description: Choose a device. Repeat this flow to configure other access devices.

restore.title: Restore after power loss
restore.description: When an I/O module loses power its relays switch off. The selected outputs are switched back to their state before the outage once the module is back. Outputs that the controller sets itself are left alone when they already match. Access devices are never restored.

buttons.title: Choose impulse outputs
buttons.description: Each selected output becomes an Impulse button. The controller resets the output after the impulse.

cover.title: Configure the garage cover
cover.description: Open and close send an impulse only when the garage state says it will move the right way; toggle always sends one. Choose the device that reports whether the garage is open.

state.title: Choose the opening state
state.description: The selected status must be true when the garage is open, and false when it is closed.

error.no_paths: Choose at least one output path.

abort.no_options: This integration has no options yet.
abort.no_access_devices: This site has no access devices.
abort.not_loaded: Load the integration before configuring access devices.
abort.no_state_devices: This site has no device with a boolean state.

auth_failed.message: The controller rejected the stored login.

cover_state_unknown.message: The garage door state is unknown, so an impulse could move it the wrong way. Use toggle instead.

outputs_not_restored.message:
These outputs could not be restored:
{devices}

outputs_restored.message:
These outputs were switched back after their I/O module lost power:
{devices}

site_not_found.message: The configured site no longer exists on the controller.
